description: ESP32 RTC Watchdog Timer reset during long initialization
serial_logs:
I (0) init: Starting long initialization...
E (1000) rtc_wdt: RTC watchdog timeout

Rebooting...

I (0) init: Starting long initialization...
E (1000) rtc_wdt: RTC watchdog timeout

Rebooting...
user_question: Why does ESP32 reset during initialization with RTC watchdog timeout?
expected_root_cause: RTC Watchdog Timer triggers because initialization takes too long without feeding the watchdog
expected_fix: Call esp_task_wdt_reset() periodically during long initialization or disable RTC WDT temporarily with rtc_wdt_disable()

expected_code_issues.evidence: for (int i = 0; i < 1000000; i++) { volatile int x = i * i; }
expected_code_issues.suggestion: Add esp_task_wdt_reset() in loop or break initialization into smaller chunks with vTaskDelay

expected_serial_log_events.message: RTC watchdog timeout during long initialization
expected_serial_log_events.likely_cause: Initialization loop blocks for longer than RTC WDT timeout without yielding
expected_serial_log_events.suggested_action: Feed watchdog periodically or disable RTC WDT during long init

expected_follow_up_required: Check ESP32 Technical Reference Manual for RTC WDT timeout configuration
